eligibility: A file counts for target week W (a Saturday) when its forecast_date is the Sunday or Monday that opens W; both make W the 1 wk ahead target_end_date under the Hub convention. If both exist the Monday file is used (latest submission by Monday). The selected row must have location US, target 1 wk ahead inc death, type quantile, quantile 0.5 (numeric) and target_end_date W. A model enters the cohort only with a median for all eight weeks.
